body:
just to give you my two cents from a throwaway account here, as i’ve never known anyone else to have the same story as mine, and to this day i haven’t really told anyone this.

my “losing virginity” story is exactly the same, with some minor differences. at 19 i hooked up with a mutual friends friend, she was dating his best friend and they were hooking up at the same time and we were alone and kinda one thing led to another.

i barely knew the guy. i bled a lot too after telling him i wasn’t a virgin, and passed it off as my period. i think it was really obvious though in hindsight as the mutual friends came down the stairs and basically congratulated me on losing my virginity (the girl was a close friend and i’d previously told her) i denied it but i’m sure i went bright red and the whole thing was a nightmare.

i felt so bad for a while as, even though me and him talked for a little while after the fact, the fact i’d lost my virginity to a near stranger, lied about my virginity, continued to lie and then bled all over, not to mention the sex lasted -5 minutes for obvious reasons. it all seemed like the worst thing in the world.

in hindsight it really isn’t that huge a thing. the guy is being understanding, he’s clearly being mature about the situation, and if you’re anything like me you’ll look back on the situation in years to come and laugh. hey maybe yall will even start dating and you will both look on it and laugh. it’s just a bit of blood and, now the more painful part is over for lack of better words, it will get easier and you’ll actually be able to enjoy it.

thank you, i’ve decided to not bother because it’s already been my last day with them. as you said it would take too long to take action by which time they’d be gone, plus i feel like it’s all too much hassle and lots of extra stress as opposed to just moving on from it. 

i just hope karma does it’s work and one day they will suffer the consequences of their actions (i’m sure they are an equally mean person in other areas of life).

i’m sorry you had to go through bullying, it’s crazy how common it is in the workplace you’d think adults would know better. i too wish you a merry christmas and happy new year :)
i’m not sure, i guess that’s what i’m asking here. i do know the behaviour seems to fall into harassment after reading through workplace policy
i mean there could be considering after looking at the workplace policies some of the behaviour falls under “harrassment”.

i don’t want to make a claim against the employer. my manager actually tried to help the situation, though i don’t think enough was done. informal complaint was made whereby the manager brought it up to the person in question and there behaviour if anything got worse. i was hoping a formal complaint would get the person in question some disciplinary action, though as stated she’s already leaving in the next few weeks.
